item.title: Statement from the Communist Party of Ireland (Marxist Leninist) on standing 3 candidates in the October 1974 UK Election
item.description: A Six page Press Statement from the Communist Party of Ireland (Marxist Leninist) on standing 3 candidates in the October 1974 UK Election. The candidates were David Vipond who polled 154 votes in South Down, Peter Kerins who polled 203 votes in West Belfast and Alan Evans who polled 185 votes in Fermanagh South Tyrone. […]

item.title: Leaflet from Mary Humphreys – Independent – Westmeath -1992 General Election
item.description: A leaflet from Independent candidate Mary Humphreys running in Westmeath in the 1992 General Election. She polled 735 votes and missed out on a seat.

item.title: Leaflet from Charles Haughey – Fianna Fáil -1956 Dublin North East By-Election
item.description: From the 1956 Dublin North East By-Election (caused by the death of Alfie Byrne) a leaflet from Charles Haughey running for Fianna Fáil. He polled 13,950 votes losing out to Alfie Byrnes son Patrick ,who polled 18129 votes.

item.title: Leaflet from John O’Connell, Michael O’Leary, Jane Dillon-Byrne – Labour – Dublin -1979 European Elections
item.description: From the 1979 European Elections a leaflet for John O’Connell, Michael O’Leary and Jane Dillon-Byrne who were running for Labour in Dublin. O’Connell and O’Leary were elected. Both later left the Party with O’Leary , despite having been party leader joining Fine Gael and O’Connell becoming an Independent before joining Fianna Fáil.

Helena McAuliffe-Ennis polled 3463 vote and Daniel O’Sullivan polled 1938 votes , neither won a seat. item.title: Leaflet from Seamus Mallon – SDLP – Newry and Armagh -1987 Westminster Election
item.description: From the 1987 UK Election a leaflet from Seamus Mallon of the SDLP running in Newry and Armagh. He polled 25,137 votes to win the seat with a majority of 5,325 votes.

item.title: Leaflet from Seán McCool – Republican – 1933 Northern Ireland Election – Derry City/Foyle
item.description: From the 1933 Northern Ireland Election a leaflet from Seán McCool running as a Republican un Derry City-Foyle. He polled 3,031 votes whilst his opponent James McCarroll (Nationalist) polled 6,557 votes. McCool was a prominent Republican and former Chief of staff of the IRA. PDF of the leaflet here
